sources.snippet: The YOLO26 model family is built around four design areas: Native end-to-end inference: The optional one-to-one detection head produces predictions without non-maximum suppression (NMS), simplifying deployment and reducing post-processing. Lighter box regression: YOLO26 removes Distribution Focal Loss (DFL), reducing detection-head complexity while preserving an unconstrained regression range ...
